text.description_html:
Stainless Steel Longstock Lever pair with spindle AHI-SIG126

The AHI SIG126 has a square block flat style hand grip. This is a great compliment to a modern design home, with sharp edges and clean lines. It's a beautiful yet functional piece.

The lever is solid stainless steel, making it extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasions. It will not degrade in appearance or function even after many years of use on your home or office. A perfect addition to your decor.

Features of AHI SIG126 Stainless Steel Levers:

  • Width: 4.92" (125mm)
  • Grip Thickness: 0.98 x 0.31" (25mm x 8mm)
  • Projection: 1.46" (38mm)
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Residential and Commercial Doors
  • Polished Stainless Steel Finish
  • All Levers meet Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)

**Includes two levers and spindle only**
